analysis.headline: Referred to the Senate Finance Committee on the day it was introduced; no hearing, markup, or vote followed before the 118th Congress ended.
analysis.plain_summary: When a company buys back its own shares, it raises the price of the remaining shares, which mostly benefits large shareholders and executives paid in stock. Since 2023 there has been a 1% excise tax on buybacks. This bill would raise that tax to 4%.
analysis.who_benefits: The public treasury, and indirectly anyone who depends on federal spending, since a higher buyback tax raises revenue and nudges companies toward investment, wages, or dividends instead of share repurchases.

how_it_helps.text: Quadruples the excise tax on corporate stock repurchases from 1% to 4%.
Makes buybacks less attractive relative to reinvesting in workers and equipment, the stated aim of the sponsors.

analysis.who_pays: Corporations that repurchase large volumes of their own shares, and through them the largest shareholders and stock-compensated executives who gain most from buybacks.

drawbacks.text: Buybacks return cash to shareholders including pension funds and retirement accounts, so part of the cost lands on ordinary savers.
A higher tax may push companies toward dividends rather than investment, which would raise revenue without changing corporate behavior.

analysis.benefit_vs_cost: The revenue gain is real and falls mainly on concentrated shareholders, but the behavioral effect is uncertain; the 1% tax enacted in 2022 did not visibly slow buybacks.

outcome.mechanism: Died in the Senate Finance Committee at the end of the 118th Congress without a hearing or markup.

narrative.text: Introduced by Sen. Sherrod Brown on February 14, 2023 with 9 cosponsors and referred to the Committee on Finance the same day.
No further action was recorded before the Congress ended on January 3, 2025.

key_actors.name: Senate Committee on Finance
key_actors.what_they_did: Received the bill on referral and took no recorded action on it.

key_actors.name: Sherrod Brown
key_actors.what_they_did: Introduced the bill and gathered 9 cosponsors.
